title: Night intrusion at the cabin when the implant was put in

tellings.quote: but as I'm turning, I see a woman standing at near the foot of the bed. She's already in the room and a man beside her. And I hear a voice in the backyard, male voice, go, "Condition red."

plain: One night in 1989 at his cabin in upstate New York, the writer Whitley Strieber says he turned and saw a woman already standing near the foot of the bed with a man beside her, while a male voice in the backyard said "Condition red." Strieber, who says he has met aliens, tells this as the night an implant was put in his body. If true, it would mean beings, or people working with them, came into his home to do it.
